summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## ARCA-61 Plan — Saved card lists not persisting  ### What I did (read-only) Traced the full path: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `modules/watchlist/schema.ts` → SQLite (`data/arca.db`), and compared it against the portfolio module and the auth/session layer (`db/auth.ts`, `modules/auth/handlers.ts`, `server.ts`).  **Finding: I could not confirm the bug the ticket hypothesizes.** In the current code: - Every watchlist route is gated by its own `Hono` middleware (`handlers.ts:13-21`) that requires the `arca_session` cookie, resolves
